study.question: Does the supplied order of valid historical events improve full-population validation click AUC beyond complete event content in the imported strongest joint model, after capacity matching and accounting for measured cost?
study.hypothesis: The imported joint model may exploit useful association between event content and supplied positions through ten fixed blocks, local/coarse/quadratic moments, rotated target-match normalization supports and nonlinear block summaries. Its click advantage over DIN does not attribute any value to supplied order. Canonicalizing complete authorized event tuples before every such path removes supplied order while retaining content, eligibility, support pattern and learned capacity. Predict a reproducible supplied-order advantage over canonical order if this association is useful under the frozen recipe. This is a prospective local falsification study, with no verified novelty claim.

nearest_work.difference: Imported source SHA256 8510b32102c1bdce1338328127aef1e4241c4cf592c7f123f551bae0e733ae4a is the closest utility reference. Keep a byte-identical standalone control; replace only the presentation order of complete valid events before embedding, matching, compression, scorer moments and all task readouts. Its 0.6685268680 click AUC is a single imported result, not evidence for useful order.

Read baseline_reference.py; target-weighted event summation has no explicit position coefficients. Its click AUC 0.6555440824 and stronger auxiliary AUCs are contextual empirical evidence, not a matched order control for the joint model.

Read archived exact-version primary text, content SHA256 5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2, lines268-283: unnormalized candidate-conditioned weighted sum and a reported unsuccessful LSTM attempt. That external negative trajectory is not transferable evidence about local event order. Retain inherited DIN-like scoring rather than claiming an original scorer or exact paper reproduction.

Pinned benchmark implementation SHA256 3d9ba455a8b765bc778f1fa0dcd00d07680a0d9019e792371ef5346d90dd3e31, lines176-200, flattens history before joint tokenization. Here preserve the existing compressed joint model and test supplied order directly. Original paper text is unavailable through authorized registry; fallback benchmark section2.3 was read. No original-method or priority claim.

Pinned benchmark implementation SHA256 ff8b2e9cf9112ff50a807e1b85b8236ecaa699f842b93b6209630cace8b454a3, lines113-159, target-pools history before heterogeneous/task token interaction. Here retain existing product fusion/task adapters and perturb event order before all history paths. Original paper is link-only; no HiFormer reproduction or effectiveness claim.

inherited_components: Entire imported strongest joint architecture, including feature/action tables, unnormalized action-aware scorer, four towers, five masked match/moment details, ten fixed compression blocks and task-specific residual bank.

Rotated-duplicate support population, attached support gradients, folded training execution, fully pruned evaluation, auxiliary primary populations, independent auxiliary normalization buffers and existing gradient ownership.
Context/history rank16 product fusion, RMS normalization and blockwise tanh projection; all initializations, learned tensors, native Dice buffers and BCE training remain inherited.
Frozen100-event prefix, official_offline visibility, every event-field/action alignment, task eligibility and original valid destination slots.
study.proposed_difference: Four cells: (1) unchanged imported supplied-order utility control; (2) candidate lexicographic canonical order; (3) reverse supplied order, an invertible information-preserving orientation control; (4) reverse canonical order, a second order-invariant orientation control. In transformed modules _history_layout is called immediately after get_inputs and shape validation, before embeddings or auxiliary union. Lexicographic keys are the ordered item_fields followed by historical action and all four supplied task masks in frozen label order. Use stable least-significant-key sorts then stable validity partition, rank valid destination slots and gather one common source index into every event field and every task mask. The current target and action column and invalid destination slots are copied exactly; history_mask is untouched. No source index survives into model features. Equal complete tuples are identical downstream. No random permutation, timestamp, new event, new parameter, new loss or train/eval treatment mismatch. Canonical rank is a content grouping over nominal encoded IDs, not chronological time. Invariance is conditional on unchanged validity pattern; official pre-padding thus retains history length. All cells train from scratch under their own treatment. A prediction-time permutation alone is neither the main contrast nor evidence of predictive order utility.
predictions: Primary prospective comparison: unchanged supplied order versus canonical forward under the frozen common seed and full validation. If supplied positions carry useful information accessible to the inherited model, unchanged should beat canonical forward and the advantage should survive reverse-orientation controls and authorized paired repetition.

Predeclare absolute click-AUC practical margin0.0002 as an engineering decision threshold, not an estimated noise level or significance cutoff. A repeatable canonical result within0.0002 or better than unchanged weakens practical order necessity; intervals spanning the margin are inconclusive. No single-seed significance claim.

Supplied reversal retains all event-order information via an invertible map conditional on mask. If its training result differs substantially, orientation/group boundaries/optimization remain consequential, weakening a uniquely temporal interpretation.

Canonical forward and reverse must be invariant, up to host numeric tolerance, to arbitrary valid-event permutations transporting fields/actions/ALL eligibility masks with fixed destination validity. Empty/singleton histories must be unchanged; original targets, all per-task eligible event multisets and validity patterns must match exactly.

Learned parameter counts and construction are exactly matched by source, with expected imported counts32192421 total,31793216 embedding,399205 dense, subject to host verification. Canonical sorting introduces extra work and may lose even if its AUC matches; report end-to-end measured cost instead of assuming equal FLOPs.

Use the existing history bins empty,1-16,17-64,>64 and all four task AUC/Logloss descriptively. Any order-associated advantage plausibly concentrates among multi-event histories, but exploratory slices do not replace full-population click selection.
falsifiers: Canonical order equal or better across authorized paired repetitions falsifies practically useful supplied-order dependence for this tested model/recipe at the predeclared margin. One replacement failure does not prove the complete event multiset lacks sufficient predictive information.

A change in any target, valid event multiset, event-action-mask alignment, per-task eligible multiset, invalid destination content, parameter count or gradient ownership invalidates the order attribution and blocks training until repaired.

Canonical predictions depending on original valid-event permutation beyond numerical tolerance refute the implementation claim of order invariance. Test nonzero residual/interaction output weights, not just their zero-initialized state.
Only inference-time permutation sensitivity, or an advantage that disappears or changes sign under order-preserving reversal/paired repetitions, does not establish useful order information.

A repeatable AUC gain smaller than0.0002 combined with >5percent added train or inference cost is not enough for a practical efficiency claim. Report a quality-cost frontier when neither treatment dominates, without assuming all users share that tradeoff.
alternative_explanations: Canonical grouping changes compressed event mixtures, target-match centering, rotated support memberships, Dice populations and optimization. These are downstream consequences of the treatment; capacity matching does not isolate each mediator or prove information-theoretic order necessity.

Nominal encoded-ID ordering can accidentally group similar/high-frequency events or proxy chronology already present in content. Canonical reverse changes orientation but not primary key priority; two canonical orientations do not exhaust order-invariant representations.
Reversal shifts block boundary memberships with partial blocks and inherited gates. It is an information-preserving control, not a guarantee of equal optimization or architectural equivariance.

Single frozen seed, one training pass, user dependence, repeated validation use and four-arm model selection can explain small differences. Use paired seeds and paired user-cluster bootstrap only through an authorized host interface; no raw user IDs are exposed to model code.

Official offline action visibility, whole-window vocabularies and static snapshots remain inherited benchmark limitations. This study neither establishes production point-in-time validity nor assumes unavailable timestamps/time gaps.

DIN versus imported joint model is architecturally confounded. Its click gain0.0129827856 comes with lower cart/fav/buy AUCs and greater latency, so neither global multitask superiority nor order attribution follows.
